title: The Bank That Kept Saying Yes to Trump

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日简报《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举办的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 届时，你可以观看其中一些未经修饰、直言不讳的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日话题。

sentences.en: At a time when most Wall Street firms had stopped doing business with Donald Trump, a single bank lent him more than $2 billion.
sentences.zh: 在大多数华尔街公司都停止与唐纳德·特朗普开展业务时，有一家银行却借给了他超过20亿美元。

sentences.en: Natalie Kitchareff talks to our colleague,
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉·基查列夫采访了我们的同事，

sentences.en: David Enrich, about a two-decade-long relationship that could unlock the president's financial secrets.
sentences.zh: 大卫·恩里奇，探讨了一段长达二十年的关系，这段关系或许能揭开总统的财务秘密。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, May 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月23日，星期四。

sentences.en: So, um, what's the story of Deutsche Bank?
sentences.zh: 那么，嗯，德意志银行的故事是怎样的？

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I can go back 150 years.
sentences.zh: 我可以追溯到150年前。

sentences.en: Is that what we want to do?
sentences.zh: 这是我们想做的吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So, founded in 1870, it was a bank that was supposed to help German companies expand all over the world.
sentences.zh: 它成立于1870年，当时是一家旨在帮助德国企业向全球扩张的银行。

sentences.en: And it banked exclusively for German companies.
sentences.zh: 而且它只为德国公司提供银行服务。

sentences.en: It was primarily a financer of infrastructure projects, so it did a lot of railroad work, things like that.
sentences.zh: 它主要是一家基础设施项目的融资方，所以它做了很多铁路工程之类的事情。

sentences.en: And this is all going well and according to plan until the rise of Hitler and the Nazis in the 1930s.
sentences.zh: 这一切进展顺利，按计划进行，直到20世纪30年代希特勒和纳粹的崛起。

sentences.en: And at this point, Deutsche Bank's role goes from being a force for industrialization and good stuff to being a force for evil.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，德意志银行的角色从工业化和正义的推动者变成了邪恶的帮凶。

sentences.en: The bank's logo disappears and it's replaced by a swastika.
sentences.zh: 银行的标志消失了，取而代之的是纳粹万字旗。

sentences.en: Yikes.
sentences.zh: 天呐。

sentences.en: It very quickly becomes an important part of the Nazi military machine.
sentences.zh: 它很快就成为了纳粹军事机器的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: Deutsche Bank financed the construction of Auschwitz.
sentences.zh: 德意志银行资助了奥斯威辛集中营的建设。

sentences.en: It financed the company that was making chemicals and gas for Auschwitz's gas chambers.
sentences.zh: 它资助了那家为奥斯威辛毒气室制造化学品和毒气的公司。

sentences.en: And as Germany laid waste to Europe and conquered all these countries, Deutsche Bank would
sentences.zh: 随着德国蹂躏欧洲并征服了所有这些国家，德意志银行会

sentences.en: come in and take over those countries' banks and conduct what's called Aryanization, basically removing Jews and other non-Aryans from these companies and replacing them.
sentences.zh: 介入并接管这些国家的银行，进行所谓的“雅利安化”，基本上就是将犹太人和其他非雅利安人从这些公司中清除并替换掉。

sentences.en: So it's part and parcel of the Nazi military machine.
sentences.zh: 所以它是纳粹军事机器不可分割的一部分。

sentences.en: And after the war ends, the bank's CEO is tried and convicted of being a war criminal.
sentences.zh: 战争结束后，该银行的首席执行官因战争罪被审判并定罪。

sentences.en: The bank is regarded by the Western powers as having been a participant in war crimes and being a criminal entity.
sentences.zh: 西方列强认为该银行参与了战争罪行，是一个犯罪实体。

sentences.en: So what happens to Deutsche Bank after the war?
sentences.zh: 那么战后德意志银行发生了什么？

sentences.en: After the war, it becomes a leading force for the reconstruction, redevelopment and reunification of Europe.
sentences.zh: 战后，它成为了欧洲重建、再开发和统一的领军力量。

sentences.en: And the bank and its leaders, they essentially become a force for good in the world and help rebuild the Western world that has been shattered by World War II.
sentences.zh: 银行及其领导人本质上成为了世界的一股正义力量，帮助重建了被第二次世界大战摧毁的西方世界。

sentences.en: And this lasts for a couple of decades.
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续了几十年。

sentences.en: And then there's this succession of CEOs who try to figure out which direction to take the bank.
sentences.zh: 随后，历任首席执行官开始摸索银行的发展方向。

sentences.en: And the choice they take is to go headlong along this path of chasing
sentences.zh: 他们最终选择的道路是全力以赴地追逐

sentences.en: Wall Street riches.
sentences.zh: 华尔街的财富。

sentences.en: And that means they all of a sudden need to go from basically zero to 60 in the
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们必须突然间在美国实现

sentences.en: United States.
sentences.zh: 从零到六十的飞速增长。

sentences.en: And that leads them to decide to start getting into all these new businesses in the
sentences.zh: 这促使他们决定开始涉足美国的所有这些新业务，

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国。

sentences.en: They want to get bigger in stock and bond trading.
sentences.zh: 他们想在股票和债券交易方面做大。

sentences.en: They want to get bigger in mergers and acquisitions.
sentences.zh: 他们想在并购业务方面做大。

sentences.en: And they want to get bigger in commercial real estate, especially in New York
sentences.zh: 他们想在商业房地产领域做大，特别是在纽约

sentences.en: City.
sentences.zh: 市。

sentences.en: So how are they received on Wall Street?
sentences.zh: 那么他们在华尔街受到怎样的欢迎呢？

sentences.en: Does anybody know them?
sentences.zh: 有人认识他们吗？

sentences.en: No, no one can even pronounce their name.
sentences.zh: 不，甚至没人能读对他们的名字。

sentences.en: There's a wonderful anecdote about how one day a sign appeared in the lobby of the offices and it was a phonetic pronunciation of how to say the bank's name.
sentences.zh: 有一个很棒的轶事，说有一天办公室大厅里出现了一个标志，上面用拼音标注了银行名字的读法。

sentences.en: And it turned out the reason that sign was necessary is that a lot of employees have been mispronouncing their employer's name as douche bank.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，之所以需要这个标志，是因为很多员工一直把雇主的名字读成“Douche Bank”（混蛋银行）。

sentences.en: Yikes, it's problematic.
sentences.zh: 天呐，这真是有问题。

sentences.en: So what's the strategy?
sentences.zh: 那么策略是什么呢？

sentences.en: If nobody can even pronounce your name, what's the strategy you pursue on Wall Street?
sentences.zh: 如果没人能读对你的名字，你在华尔街采取的策略是什么？

sentences.en: You take more risks than anyone else.
sentences.zh: 你比任何人都更敢于冒险。

sentences.en: It's that simple.
sentences.zh: 就这么简单。

sentences.en: There's a whole kind of category of potential clients out there that can't be banked by normal financial institutions because they're considered too risky.
sentences.zh: 市场上有一大类潜在客户，因为被认为风险太高，无法从正常的金融机构获得贷款。

sentences.en: They've defaulted on past loans.
sentences.zh: 他们过去有违约记录。

sentences.en: The projects they're pursuing are crazy.
sentences.zh: 他们追求的项目非常疯狂。

sentences.en: And this is a whole kind of group of people that's out there that is very eager to find a big bank that's willing to do business with them.
sentences.zh: 而这群人非常渴望找到一家愿意与他们做生意的大银行。

sentences.en: And Deutsche Bank decides to fill that void.
sentences.zh: 于是德意志银行决定填补这一空白。

sentences.en: And so summer of 1998, phone rings at Deutsche Bank and there's a broker on the line who says, would you be willing to make a loan to Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 1998年夏天，德意志银行的电话响了，一位经纪人在电话里问，你们愿意借钱给唐纳德·特朗普吗？

sentences.en: And the guy in the commercial real estate business at Deutsche Bank says, we would be willing to make a loan to just about anybody right now.
sentences.zh: 德意志银行负责商业房地产业务的人说，我们现在几乎愿意借钱给任何人。

sentences.en: Have him come on in.
sentences.zh: 让他过来吧。

sentences.en: What's Trump's reputation on Wall Street at this point?
sentences.zh: 当时特朗普在华尔街的名声如何？

sentences.en: Deadbeat.
sentences.zh: 赖账鬼。

sentences.en: He keeps defaulting on loans.
sentences.zh: 他不断地拖欠贷款。

sentences.en: He keeps sticking lenders with hundreds of millions of dollars of losses.
sentences.zh: 他不断让贷款方蒙受数亿美元的损失。

sentences.en: He is viewed as the embodiment of a bad credit risk.
sentences.zh: 他被视为不良信用风险的化身。

sentences.en: This is long before he becomes a reality TV star.
sentences.zh: 这远在他成为真人秀明星之前。

sentences.en: So this is in 1998.
sentences.zh: 所以这是在1998年。

sentences.en: He at this point is a not very successful casino magnet and aspiring big ticket real estate developer.
sentences.zh: 当时的他还不是什么成功的赌场大亨，只是个有抱负的大型房地产开发商。

sentences.en: And so Trump comes on in by himself, no entourage or anything, and presents a proposal.
sentences.zh: 于是特朗普独自前来，没有随从或其他人，并提交了一份提案。

sentences.en: He's looking to finance the kind of gut renovation of this art deco tower, 40 Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 他寻求为这座装饰艺术风格的大楼——华尔街40号——进行彻底翻新融资。

sentences.en: Before the ink is even dried on that loan, they agree to do another loan to do the ground up construction of a residential tower right across from the U.N.
sentences.zh: 在那笔贷款墨迹未干之前，他们就同意再发放一笔贷款，用于在联合国总部对面建造一栋住宅大楼。

sentences.en: in midtown
sentences.zh: 在曼哈顿中城。

sentences.en: Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 曼哈顿。

sentences.en: And it's just off to the races from there.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，一切就一发不可收拾了。

sentences.en: So what does Deutsche Bank get out of this relationship with Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 那么德意志银行从与唐纳德·特朗普的这种关系中得到了什么？

sentences.en: It gets two things.
sentences.zh: 它得到了两样东西。

sentences.en: It gets money and it gets publicity.
sentences.zh: 它得到了金钱，也得到了名声。

sentences.en: So the money is simple, right?
sentences.zh: 金钱方面很简单，对吧？

sentences.en: The bank charges high interest rates on these loans.
sentences.zh: 银行对这些贷款收取高额利息。

sentences.en: It also collects fees for the privilege of doing business with it.
sentences.zh: 它还收取与它开展业务的特权费用。

sentences.en: The other thing is a little more intangible, but I think equally important, which is that the bank starts to use Donald Trump as a prop to lure other clients.
sentences.zh: 另一件事虽然有点抽象，但我认为同样重要，那就是银行开始利用唐纳德·特朗普作为诱饵来吸引其他客户。

sentences.en: For example, the bank has an annual pro-am golf tournament up in Boston every fall, and Trump becomes one of the celebrity participants.
sentences.zh: 例如，银行每年秋天在波士顿举办一场职业与业余配对高尔夫锦标赛，特朗普成了名人参赛者之一。

sentences.en: And he, you know, works the crowds before and after he golfs signing their hundred dollar bills.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他在打球前后会穿梭在人群中，给他们的百元钞票签名。

sentences.en: And one year they do a promotional video and they sit Trump down in the clubhouse at the golf tournament with the cameras rolling and say, Donald, why do you like
sentences.zh: 有一年，他们制作了一段宣传视频，让特朗普坐在高尔夫锦标赛的会所里，在摄像机拍摄下问他：唐纳德，你为什么喜欢

sentences.en: doing business with Deutsche Bank?
sentences.zh: 和德意志银行做生意？

sentences.en: And he says, with a big smile on his face, because they're so fast and easy.
sentences.zh: 他脸上带着灿烂的笑容说：因为他们办事又快又容易。

sentences.en: So for now, everything's kind of hunky-dory.
sentences.zh: 所以目前为止，一切都还算顺利。

sentences.en: Things are going well, right?
sentences.zh: 事情进展得很顺利，对吧？

sentences.en: Everyone's happy.
sentences.zh: 每个人都很高兴。

sentences.en: What happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So the early 2000s, Trump comes back to Deutsche Bank for another financial project.
sentences.zh: 21世纪初，特朗普又带着另一个金融项目回到了德意志银行。

sentences.en: And this one is different.
sentences.zh: 而这次有所不同。

sentences.en: He's not looking to build a building or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 他不是要盖楼或类似的事情。

sentences.en: What he's looking for is money for his Atlantic City casinos.
sentences.zh: 他想要的是为他的大西洋城赌场筹集资金。

sentences.en: And his casino company is deep in debt.
sentences.zh: 他的赌场公司债台高筑。

sentences.en: And so he gets Deutsche Bank to agree to help the casino company sell a bunch of bonds.
sentences.zh: 于是他让德意志银行同意帮助赌场公司出售一批债券。

sentences.en: And so the way that works is there's something called a roadshow.
sentences.zh: 运作方式是进行所谓的路演。

sentences.en: And Trump and Deutsche Bank go off to meet a bunch of institutional investors.
sentences.zh: 特朗普和德意志银行去见了一群机构投资者。

sentences.en: And Trump is supposed to kind of give his financial pitch for why these investors shouldn't trust their money with his casino company.
sentences.zh: 特朗普本应就为什么这些投资者应该把钱投给他的赌场公司发表财务演讲。

sentences.en: And the roadshow seems to be going really well.
sentences.zh: 路演看起来进行得非常顺利。

sentences.en: There's big crowds.
sentences.zh: 现场人头攒动。

sentences.en: You know, people bring cameras to the events.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们带着相机参加活动。

sentences.en: And at the end of this, Trump goes to his banker at Deutsche and says, that went great.
sentences.zh: 活动结束后，特朗普找到他在德意志银行的银行家说：进展太棒了。

sentences.en: How much money did we raise?
sentences.zh: 我们筹集了多少钱？

sentences.en: And the poor banker needs to break the news to Trump that, yes, they did attract large crowds.
sentences.zh: 那位可怜的银行家不得不向特朗普透露消息：是的，他们确实吸引了大量人群。

sentences.en: And yes, people seemed happy to see them.
sentences.zh: 是的，人们看起来很高兴见到他们。

sentences.en: But no, people were not willing to provide him with their money.
sentences.zh: 但没有，人们并不愿意把钱交给他。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So here's Donald Trump trying to sell bonds, which basically means he's asking for loans and no one is biting.
sentences.zh: 所以唐纳德·特朗普试图出售债券，这基本上意味着他在寻求贷款，但没人买账。

sentences.en: No one would touch him.
sentences.zh: 没人愿意碰他。

sentences.en: So the roadshow was a dud.
sentences.zh: 所以路演彻底失败了。

sentences.en: And so Donald Trump comes in and assembles the group that's responsible for going out and finding buyers for these bonds.
sentences.zh: 于是唐纳德·特朗普召集了负责为这些债券寻找买家的团队。

sentences.en: And he says, listen, fellas, I know this is not the easiest project you've ever done.
sentences.zh: 他说：听着，伙计们，我知道这不是你们做过的最简单的项目。

sentences.en: But if you can get this done for me, you will all be my guests at Mar-a-Lago for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 但如果你们能为我搞定这件事，周末你们都将是我的客人，去海湖庄园度假。

sentences.en: And lo and behold, that does the trick.
sentences.zh: 结果你猜怎么着，这招奏效了。

sentences.en: The sales guys managed to actually sell nearly
sentences.zh: 销售人员竟然成功卖出了近

sentences.en: 500 million dollars of bonds, which is a very large number.
sentences.zh: 5亿美元的债券，这是一个非常大的数字。

sentences.en: It's hard to sell that much risky debt.
sentences.zh: 要卖出这么多高风险债务是很困难的。

sentences.en: So the sales process ends and the banker calls back Trump and says, great news.
sentences.zh: 销售过程结束后，银行家回电给特朗普说：好消息。

sentences.en: We did it.
sentences.zh: 我们做到了。

sentences.en: We sold, I think, 480 million dollars of these bonds for you.
sentences.zh: 我想我们为你卖出了4.8亿美元的债券。

sentences.en: And Trump is very, very happy.
sentences.zh: 特朗普非常非常高兴。

sentences.en: Big smile on his face and says, that's great.
sentences.zh: 他脸上带着灿烂的笑容说：太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And the banker says, don't forget about what you promised our guys.
sentences.zh: 银行家说：别忘了你答应我们的人的事。

sentences.en: And Trump says, what's that?
sentences.zh: 特朗普说：什么事？

sentences.en: And the banker is not sure if he's serious and says, you said you'd take them all down to Mar-a-Lago, remember?
sentences.zh: 银行家不确定他是认真的，便说：你说过要带他们去海湖庄园，还记得吗？

sentences.en: And Trump says, oh, no, no one's going to remember that.
sentences.zh: 特朗普说：哦，不，没人会记得那个。

sentences.en: I'm trying to weasel out of it.
sentences.zh: 我正试图赖掉它。

sentences.en: And the banker says, look, that's all these guys have been talking about for the past week or two.
sentences.zh: 银行家说：听着，过去一两周这些人一直在谈论这件事。

sentences.en: Trump eventually agrees.
sentences.zh: 特朗普最终同意了。

sentences.en: And he sends up his private Boeing jet to New York and flies them all down to Mar-a-Lago and spends a weekend together.
sentences.zh: 他派出了他的私人波音飞机前往纽约，把他们都接到海湖庄园，一起度过了一个周末。

sentences.en: And it's great that he's whining and dining them, telling them great stories.
sentences.zh: 他款待他们，给他们讲精彩的故事，这真是太好了。

sentences.en: And the relationship seems to have reached this new level.
sentences.zh: 这种关系似乎达到了一个新的高度。

sentences.en: So it basically means if there's an unanticipatable act of God, like a natural disaster, for example, that theoretically would allow Trump to void or delay the contract.

sentences.en: And it just so happened that a few days before the lawyers started going through these contracts with a fine tooth comb.

sentences.zh: 你认为他们在害怕什么？

sentences.en: There are a number of fears.
sentences.zh: 有很多方面的担忧。

sentences.en: The most obvious fear was just a public relations debacle.
sentences.zh: 最明显的担忧就是一场公关灾难。

sentences.en: Donald Trump owes at least $250 million to banks.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普至少欠银行2.5亿美元。

sentences.en: Deutsche Bank is reportedly the only big bank that continues to make significant loans to him.
sentences.zh: 据报道，德意志银行是唯一一家继续向他提供大额贷款的大型银行。

sentences.en: There are already headlines that were starting to come out about Deutsche Bank's pivotal role in allowing Trump to build his business and kind of help him survive financially.
sentences.zh: 当时已经开始出现关于德意志银行在帮助特朗普建立商业帝国以及在财务上维持生存方面所起关键作用的头条新闻。

sentences.en: In the first days of his campaign, Donald Trump has insisted that his record as a businessman gives him the experience he needs to run the country.
sentences.zh: 在竞选初期，唐纳德·特朗普坚称他作为商人的记录赋予了他治理国家所需的经验。

sentences.en: But is that record as good as he says?
sentences.zh: 但那份记录真的像他说的那么好吗？

sentences.en: And for someone who is not popular in most of the world and you're a global bank, that is not an attractive set of facts.
sentences.zh: 对于一个在世界上大多数地方都不受欢迎的人，而你又是一家全球性银行，这并不是一个吸引人的事实。

sentences.en: The other bigger concern, though, is Deutsche Bank executives started to realize that if Trump became president, they had a very tricky problem on their hands.
sentences.zh: 不过，另一个更大的担忧是，德意志银行的高管们开始意识到，如果特朗普当选总统，他们将面临一个非常棘手的问题。

sentences.en: And it was this because the private bank had structured these loans in a way that Donald Trump personally guaranteed the bulk of them.
sentences.zh: 原因在于，私人银行在设计这些贷款时，唐纳德·特朗普对其中的大部分提供了个人担保。

sentences.en: That meant that if Trump became president and defaulted on his loans, which empirically, that's actually the likelihood.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，如果特朗普当选总统并拖欠贷款——根据经验，这实际上很有可能发生——

sentences.en: And if he did that in office as president of the
sentences.zh: 如果他在担任美国总统期间这样做，

sentences.en: United States, that meant that Deutsche Bank would be faced with a very unattractive choice.
sentences.zh: 那就意味着德意志银行将面临一个非常尴尬的选择。

sentences.en: On the one hand, they could do what they are contractually entitled to, which is seize the president's assets.
sentences.zh: 一方面，他们可以行使合同赋予的权利，即没收总统的资产。

sentences.en: They could take his private plane.
sentences.zh: 他们可以扣押他的私人飞机。

sentences.en: They could take Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 他们可以查封海湖庄园。

sentences.en: They could empty the cash in his bank accounts.
sentences.zh: 他们可以清空他银行账户里的现金。

sentences.en: But that's picking a very public and ugly fight with the most powerful man in the world.
sentences.zh: 但这等于是与世界上最有权势的人进行一场公开且丑陋的对抗。

sentences.en: But the other option is actually in a lot of ways uglier, which is to not enforce the terms of the contract and to basically let it slide if Trump stops paying back his loans.
sentences.zh: 但另一个选择在很多方面其实更糟糕，那就是不执行合同条款，如果特朗普停止偿还贷款，就基本上听之任之。

sentences.en: That's essentially cutting an enormously lucrative break to the president, whose administration, by the way, wields
sentences.zh: 这本质上是给了总统一个极其丰厚的优待，顺便提一下，他的政府

sentences.en: enormous power over the bank because Deutsche Bank has a huge U.S.
sentences.zh: 对该银行拥有巨大的权力，因为德意志银行在美国有庞大的

sentences.en: operation and is regulated by the
sentences.zh: 业务，并受到

sentences.en: Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府的监管。

sentences.en: So both of those choices are very bad.
sentences.zh: 所以这两个选择都很糟糕。

sentences.en: And Deutsche Bank executives started to realize realize that they might be in this terrible situation.
sentences.zh: 德意志银行的高管们开始意识到，他们可能陷入了这种可怕的境地。

sentences.en: So obviously he becomes president.
sentences.zh: 显然，他当选了总统。

sentences.en: What happens?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: Deutsche Bank executives who I talked to have recalled to me waking up on November 9th, 2016,
sentences.zh: 我采访过的德意志银行高管回忆说，2016年11月9日醒来时，

sentences.en: realized that Trump had been elected president and just immediately were overwhelmed by nausea.
sentences.zh: 意识到特朗普已经当选总统，他们立刻感到一阵强烈的恶心。

sentences.en: They realized that they had a huge, huge problem on their hands.
sentences.zh: 他们意识到自己手里有一个天大的麻烦。

sentences.en: So the good news for Deutsche Bank is that at this point, both ends of Pennsylvania Avenue are controlled by Republicans.
sentences.zh: 对德意志银行来说，好消息是此时宾夕法尼亚大道的两端都由共和党人控制。

sentences.en: The Republicans are not going to investigate Deutsche Bank and its ties to Trump because they support the president.
sentences.zh: 共和党人不会调查德意志银行及其与特朗普的关系，因为他们支持总统。

sentences.en: And so for two years, Deutsche Bank executives are kind of breathing a sigh of relief a little bit.
sentences.zh: 因此，在两年时间里，德意志银行的高管们稍微松了一口气。

sentences.en: Their nightmare scenario is not likely to become reality.
sentences.zh: 他们的噩梦不太可能成为现实。

sentences.en: And then in November 2018, Democrats take the House.
sentences.zh: 然后到了2018年11月，民主党夺回了众议院。

sentences.en: Georgia, Democrats here are really stepping up their fight for the president's personal and business financial records.
sentences.zh: 佐治亚州，这里的民主党人正在真正加强对总统个人和商业财务记录的争取。

sentences.en: Frustrated House Democrats have issued a subpoena for those six years of President Trump's tax returns.
sentences.zh: 受挫的众议院民主党人已经发出了传票，要求获取特朗普总统六年的纳税申报表。

sentences.en: Issuing subpoenas to several financial institutions and the president's longtime lender, Deutsche Bank.
sentences.zh: 向几家金融机构和总统的长期贷款方德意志银行发出传票。

sentences.en: It's the latest escalation in a standoff between the president and Congress.
sentences.zh: 这是总统与国会之间对峙的最新升级。

sentences.en: And again, this time, the administration is refusing congressional demands.
sentences.zh: 而且这一次，政府再次拒绝了国会的要求。

sentences.en: So as soon as Democrats regained the House, Deutsche Bank started proactively cooperating with investigators on Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 因此，民主党一夺回众议院，德意志银行就开始主动配合国会山的调查人员。

sentences.en: So in April, two congressional committees issued subpoenas to Deutsche Bank, demanding a whole variety of very detailed financial information.
sentences.zh: 所以四月份，两个国会委员会向德意志银行发出传票，要求提供各种非常详细的财务信息。

sentences.en: A week or two before Deutsche Bank was preparing to hand that over, Trump and his family filed a
sentences.zh: 在德意志银行准备移交这些信息的一两周前，特朗普和他的家人提起了一项

sentences.en: lawsuit against Deutsche Bank, seeking to prevent it from complying with that subpoena.
sentences.zh: 针对德意志银行的诉讼，试图阻止其遵守该传票。

sentences.en: So what does Deutsche Bank represent to Democrats?
sentences.zh: 那么德意志银行对民主党人意味着什么？

sentences.en: It's the Rosetta Stone for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 它是民主党人的“罗塞塔石碑”。

sentences.en: It's the key to unlocking Donald Trump's personal and business finances.
sentences.zh: 它是解开唐纳德·特朗普个人和商业财务状况的钥匙。

sentences.en: I mean, the tax returns in particular are something that
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，特别是纳税申报表，这是

sentences.en: Trump has broken with decades of precedent and refused to publicly release his tax returns.
sentences.zh: 特朗普打破了数十年的先例，拒绝公开披露的。

sentences.en: But this actually goes way beyond the tax returns.
sentences.zh: 但这实际上远不止纳税申报表那么简单。

sentences.en: And it has the potential to answer some of the real unsolved mysteries of the Trump family finances.
sentences.zh: 它有可能解答特朗普家族财务中一些真正未解的谜团。

sentences.en: And where has he been getting his money?
sentences.zh: 他的钱是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: He's had a lot of cash.
sentences.zh: 他有很多现金。

sentences.en: Where does it come from?
sentences.zh: 它们来自哪里？

sentences.en: There's a million unanswered questions.
sentences.zh: 有无数个未解的问题。

sentences.en: And the answers to a lot of them are hiding inside an electronic vault at Deutsche Bank.
sentences.zh: 而其中许多问题的答案都隐藏在德意志银行的一个电子保险库里。

sentences.en: I can't help but note that after decades of Trump taking advantage of Deutsche
sentences.zh: 我不禁注意到，在特朗普利用德意志银行

sentences.en: Bank's willingness to bet on him, to take risks by working with him.
sentences.zh: 愿意押注于他、通过与他合作来承担风险的意愿数十年之后。

sentences.en: And after decades of him messing with them, kind of, now he's in this position where this bank that he's had this torrid,
sentences.zh: 在他与他们纠缠数十年之后，现在他处于这样一个位置：这家他曾有过一段狂热、

sentences.en: tortured, as you say, relationship with, has the key to his finances that he is so desperate to keep out of the public eye.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说的，痛苦关系的银行，掌握着他拼命想避开公众视线的财务钥匙。

sentences.en: I mean, the tables seem to have turned in this way.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，形势似乎以这种方式发生了逆转。

sentences.en: This time, Deutsche Bank is a big risk to Trump.
sentences.zh: 这一次，德意志银行对特朗普来说是一个巨大的风险。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: The risk actually still goes both ways.
sentences.zh: 这种风险实际上仍然是双向的。

sentences.en: And this is the culmination of a decades-long symbiotic, very risky relationship.
sentences.zh: 这是长达数十年的共生且高风险关系的终局。

sentences.en: Deutsche Bank has the potential to spill the president's innermost financial secrets.
sentences.zh: 德意志银行有可能泄露总统最深层的财务秘密。

sentences.en: But President Trump and his administration has enormous sway over the future course of this bank because the administration regulates the bank and the administration's
sentences.zh: 但特朗普总统及其政府对这家银行的未来走向拥有巨大的影响力，因为政府监管着该银行，而且政府的

sentences.en: Department of Justice has at least one open criminal investigation into the bank for laundering money overseas.
sentences.zh: 司法部至少有一项针对该银行在海外洗钱的公开刑事调查。

sentences.en: So it's kind of like mutually assured destruction, except for the fact that now Congress, since they have subpoenaed Deutsche Bank for the records, assuming a federal judge
sentences.zh: 所以这有点像“相互保证毁灭”，除了现在国会已经向德意志银行发出了调取记录的传票，假设联邦法官

sentences.en: does not get in the way of the bank complying, Deutsche Bank is going to be handing over some extremely explosive materials for the whole world to see.
sentences.zh: 不阻碍银行合规，德意志银行将移交一些极其爆炸性的材料供全世界观看。

sentences.en: These are all secrets that Trump has spent the past several years trying to keep hidden from public view.
sentences.zh: 这些都是特朗普过去几年一直试图向公众隐瞒的秘密。

sentences.en: And there's a very real chance that right now they could all come tumbling out.
sentences.zh: 而且现在很有可能这一切都会曝光。

sentences.en: David, thank you.
sentences.zh: 大卫，谢谢你。

sentences.en: It's my pleasure.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: On Wednesday afternoon, a federal judge rejected President Trump's request to block Deutsche
sentences.zh: 周三下午，一名联邦法官驳回了特朗普总统阻止德意志

sentences.en: Bank from complying with congressional subpoenas for his financial records.
sentences.zh: 银行遵守国会传票以获取其财务记录的请求。

sentences.en: The judge dismissed the president's argument that the subpoenas have no legitimate purpose and were being used
sentences.zh: 法官驳回了总统关于传票没有合法目的且被用于

sentences.en: to harass him, concluding that his argument would not prevail at trial.
sentences.zh: 骚扰他的论点，并得出结论称他的论点在审判中不会胜诉。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: So I came here to do a meeting on infrastructure with Democrats, not really thinking they wanted to do infrastructure or anything else other than investigate.
sentences.zh: 我来这里是为了和民主党人开会讨论基础设施问题，并没有想到他们除了调查之外还想做基础设施或其他任何事情。

sentences.en: President Trump on Wednesday stormed out of a scheduled meeting with Democratic leaders
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统周三冲出了与民主党领导人预定的会议，

sentences.en: about infrastructure and declared that he was no longer willing to work with them until they end the congressional investigations into his conduct.
sentences.zh: 讨论基础设施问题，并宣布在他们结束对他的行为进行国会调查之前，他不再愿意与他们合作。

sentences.en: And I just saw that Nancy Pelosi, just before our meeting, made a statement that we believe that the president of the United States is engaged in a cover-up.
sentences.zh: 我刚才看到南希·佩洛西在我们的会议前发表声明说，我们认为美国总统参与了掩盖真相的行为。

sentences.en: Well, it turns out I'm the most, and I think most of you would agree to this, I'm the most transparent president probably in the history of this country.
sentences.zh: 好吧，事实证明我是最透明的总统，我想你们大多数人都会同意这一点，我可能是这个国家历史上最透明的总统。

sentences.en: After cutting short the meeting at the White House, the president marched into the Rose Garden to recount his confrontation with the Democrats,
sentences.zh: 在缩短了白宫的会议后，总统大步走进玫瑰园，讲述了他与民主党人的对抗，

sentences.en: which included House Speaker Nancy Pelosi and Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer.
sentences.zh: 其中包括众议院议长南希·佩洛西和参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默。

sentences.en: So I just wanted to let you know that I walked into the room and I told
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想让你们知道，我走进房间并告诉

sentences.en: Senator Schumer, Speaker Pelosi, I want to do infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 舒默参议员、佩洛西议长，我想做基础设施建设。

sentences.en: I want to do it more than you want to do it.
sentences.zh: 我想做这件事的意愿比你们更强烈。

sentences.en: I'd be really good at that.
sentences.zh: 我在这方面会做得非常好。

sentences.en: That's what I do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的专长。

sentences.en: But you know what?
sentences.zh: 但你知道吗？

sentences.en: You can't do it under these circumstances.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下你做不到。

sentences.en: So get these phony investigations over with.
sentences.zh: 所以把这些虚假的调查结束吧。

sentences.en: Afterward, both Schumer and Pelosi accused the president of staging his walkout, calling it a political performance that allowed him to avoid the difficult work of creating an
sentences.zh: 事后，舒默和佩洛西都指责总统策划了他的离场，称这是一场政治表演，让他得以逃避制定

sentences.en: infrastructure plan.
sentences.zh: 基础设施计划的艰苦工作。

sentences.en: It's clear that this was not a spontaneous move on the president's part.
sentences.zh: 很明显，这不是总统自发的举动。

sentences.en: It was planned.
sentences.zh: 这是有预谋的。

sentences.en: And of course, then he went to the Rose Garden with prepared signs that had been printed up long before our meeting.
sentences.zh: 当然，随后他带着在会议前很久就印好的准备好的标语去了玫瑰园。

sentences.en: We want the president to do infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 我们希望总统进行基础设施建设。

sentences.en: We want our Congress to perform its constitutional responsibilities and create jobs, create income, create wealth for the average American.
sentences.zh: 我们希望我们的国会履行其宪法职责，创造就业机会，创造收入，为普通美国人创造财富。

sentences.en: We can do both.
sentences.zh: 我们可以两者兼顾。

sentences.en: It's clear the president doesn't want to do any of that.
sentences.zh: 很明显，总统不想做任何这些事情。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在您获取播客的任何地方收听。
